text: ＊は　げきりゅうに　たちむかうため　ひでんわざ　たきのぼりを　つかった！

structure.jp: げきりゅうに　たちむかうため
structure.en: in order to take on the raging current

structure.jp: ひでんわざ　たきのぼりを

patterns.name: 〜ため
patterns.explanation: ため after a verb tells you the goal that the rest of the sentence is done for. たちむかうため = 'in order to take on'.
